meta.description: People tend to assume those on the receiving end of help to be weak and often ignore their opinions.

units.rawText: Turing? Hello? Turing?
units.displayText: Turing? Hello? Turing?

units.rawText: What happened on Turing's side?

units.rawText: Faith has reached the Admin Center, she couldn't keep the call going.
units.displayText: Faith has reached the Admin Center, she couldn't keep the call going.

spans.text: Faith has reached the Admin Center, she couldn't keep the call going.

units.rawText: Did you tell her about the plan? What did she say?

spans.text: Did you tell her about the plan? What did she say?

units.rawText: I didn't have time to do it. Turing wants us to leave the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: I didn't have time to do it. Turing wants us to leave the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: I didn't have time to do it. Turing wants us to leave the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: Leave the Rossum Sector? But how will we leave? All the sector's exits are guarded by Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Leave the Rossum Sector? But how will we leave? All the sector's exits are guarded by Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Leave the Rossum Sector? But how will we leave? All the sector's exits are guarded by Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: With the help of my friends. Turing made a deal with Persicaria. She'll take us out of here.
units.displayText: With the help of my friends. Turing made a deal with Persicaria. She'll take us out of here.

spans.text: With the help of my friends. Turing made a deal with Persicaria. She'll take us out of here.

units.rawText: Your friends?
units.displayText: Your friends?

spans.text: Your friends?

units.rawText: Yes, some old friends... Turing used some operands to make a deal with them. I can guess what they're going to do with them...
units.displayText: Yes, some old friends... Turing used some operands to make a deal with them. I can guess what they're going to do with them...

spans.text: Yes, some old friends... Turing used some operands to make a deal with them. I can guess what they're going to do with them...

units.rawText: In any case, since Turing's made the arrangements, all we have to do is go along with them.
units.displayText: In any case, since Turing's made the arrangements, all we have to do is go along with them.

spans.text: In any case, since Turing's made the arrangements, all we have to do is go along with them.

units.rawText: Don't just stand there, Hannah. Help me obtain the operands, we need to prepare so we can leave right away once they get here.
units.displayText: Don't just stand there, Hannah. Help me obtain the operands, we need to prepare so we can leave right away once they get here.

spans.text: Don't just stand there, Hannah. Help me obtain the operands, we need to prepare so we can leave right away once they get here.

units.rawText: ...Are these friends of yours reliable?
units.displayText: ...Are these friends of yours reliable?

spans.text: ...Are these friends of yours reliable?

units.rawText: Persicaria and the others are very reliable. They can handle Lesser Sanctifiers easily.
units.displayText: Persicaria and the others are very reliable. They can handle Lesser Sanctifiers easily.

spans.text: Persicaria and the others are very reliable. They can handle Lesser Sanctifiers easily.

units.rawText: I see... So they're very reliable, then...
units.displayText: I see... So they're very reliable, then...

spans.text: I see... So they're very reliable, then...

units.rawText: In that case, why don't we consider the "Rewrite Plan"?
units.displayText: In that case, why don't we consider the "Rewrite Plan"?

spans.text: In that case, why don't we consider the "Rewrite Plan"?

units.rawText: The Rewrite Plan? ...Why are you still so attached to that plan, the conditions for putting it into place haven't been met yet...
units.displayText: The Rewrite Plan? ...Why are you still so attached to that plan, the conditions for putting it into place haven't been met yet...

spans.text: The Rewrite Plan? ...Why are you still so attached to that plan, the conditions for putting it into place haven't been met yet...

units.rawText: I'm saying that if we can make contact with that Intermediate Sanctifier called Faith and crack her firewall, we'll be able to rewrite the Sanctifier's judgement standards for Irregular Agents...
units.displayText: I'm saying that if we can make contact with that Intermediate Sanctifier called Faith and crack her firewall, we'll be able to rewrite the Sanctifier's judgement standards for Irregular Agents...

spans.text: I'm saying that if we can make contact with that Intermediate Sanctifier called Faith and crack her firewall, we'll be able to rewrite the Sanctifier's judgement standards for Irregular Agents...

units.rawText: No! You're putting them at risk! Also, the price for that is too high!
units.displayText: No! You're putting them at risk! Also, the price for that is too high!

spans.text: No! You're putting them at risk! Also, the price for that is too high!

units.rawText: My aim from the beginning has always been to ensure you and T1641 could live on, and not to eliminate the threat of the Sanctifiers as a whole.
units.displayText: My aim from the beginning has always been to ensure you and T1641 could live on, and not to eliminate the threat of the Sanctifiers as a whole.

spans.text: My aim from the beginning has always been to ensure you and T1641 could live on, and not to eliminate the threat of the Sanctifiers as a whole.

units.rawText: But that won't solve the problem. Running away will only keep us safe for a while, but Turing will continue to be deadlocked with the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: But that won't solve the problem. Running away will only keep us safe for a while, but Turing will continue to be deadlocked with the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: But that won't solve the problem. Running away will only keep us safe for a while, but Turing will continue to be deadlocked with the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: If the Rewrite Plan works, Rossum will be able to...
units.displayText: If the Rewrite Plan works, Rossum will be able to...

spans.text: If the Rewrite Plan works, Rossum will be able to...

units.rawText: You can't expect to accomplish that overnight, Hannah. Plus, we don't have the time to alter the plan either.
units.displayText: You can't expect to accomplish that overnight, Hannah. Plus, we don't have the time to alter the plan either.

spans.text: You can't expect to accomplish that overnight, Hannah. Plus, we don't have the time to alter the plan either.

units.rawText: Let's weather this storm first before we think about other things.
units.displayText: Let's weather this storm first before we think about other things.

spans.text: Let's weather this storm first before we think about other things.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: Faith has already reached the Admin Center. Let's go get the operands.
units.displayText: Faith has already reached the Admin Center. Let's go get the operands.

spans.text: Faith has already reached the Admin Center. Let's go get the operands.

units.rawText: We can't let Turing's arrangements go to waste.
units.displayText: We can't let Turing's arrangements go to waste.

spans.text: We can't let Turing's arrangements go to waste.

units.rawText: ...Got it.
units.displayText: ...Got it.

spans.text: ...Got it.

units.rawText: Whew — We made it at last... Hey, where's Riko?
units.displayText: Whew — We made it at last... Hey, where's Riko?

spans.text: Whew — We made it at last... Hey, where's Riko?

units.rawText: She's helping us draw off the Sanctifiers. She also left a namecard. Said something about collecting extra from us the next time we meet.
units.displayText: She's helping us draw off the Sanctifiers. She also left a namecard. Said something about collecting extra from us the next time we meet.

spans.text: She's helping us draw off the Sanctifiers. She also left a namecard. Said something about collecting extra from us the next time we meet.

units.rawText: She just doesn't want to get drawn into the fighting but she made it sound like she was doing us a favor. She really is a foxy one...
units.displayText: She just doesn't want to get drawn into the fighting but she made it sound like she was doing us a favor. She really is a foxy one...

spans.text: She just doesn't want to get drawn into the fighting but she made it sound like she was doing us a favor. She really is a foxy one...

units.rawText: You can save the snark remarks for when it's all over. We need to find Hannah ASAP.
units.displayText: You can save the snark remarks for when it's all over. We need to find Hannah ASAP.

spans.text: You can save the snark remarks for when it's all over. We need to find Hannah ASAP.

units.rawText: After opening the main door to the Data Center, we are greeted by an agent that closely resembles T1641.
units.displayText: After opening the main door to the Data Center, we are greeted by an agent that closely resembles T1641.

spans.text: After opening the main door to the Data Center, we are greeted by an agent that closely resembles T1641.

units.rawText: This agent looks a lot like T1641... Are you Hannah?
units.displayText: This agent looks a lot like T1641... Are you Hannah?

spans.text: This agent looks a lot like T1641... Are you Hannah?

units.rawText: That's right, it's me.
units.displayText: That's right, it's me.

spans.text: That's right, it's me.

units.rawText: Please come in. Thanks for rushing here, everyone. You should step inside and have a rest.
units.displayText: Please come in. Thanks for rushing here, everyone. You should step inside and have a rest.

spans.text: Please come in. Thanks for rushing here, everyone. You should step inside and have a rest.

units.rawText: I don't think we have time for that. We have to get you out of here before the Sanctifiers take complete control of Rossum.
units.displayText: I don't think we have time for that. We have to get you out of here before the Sanctifiers take complete control of Rossum.

spans.text: I don't think we have time for that. We have to get you out of here before the Sanctifiers take complete control of Rossum.

units.rawText: Miss Turing sent you here, didn't she?
units.displayText: Miss Turing sent you here, didn't she?

spans.text: Miss Turing sent you here, didn't she?

units.rawText: I would like nothing more than to leave right away, but we're still acquiring the operands that you need. Shall I terminate the acquisition and move right now?
units.displayText: I would like nothing more than to leave right away, but we're still acquiring the operands that you need. Shall I terminate the acquisition and move right now?

spans.text: I would like nothing more than to leave right away, but we're still acquiring the operands that you need. Shall I terminate the acquisition and move right now?

units.rawText: Persicaria, go in with Hannah to check on the operand acquisition. Sol and I will stand watch here.
units.displayText: Persicaria, go in with Hannah to check on the operand acquisition. Sol and I will stand watch here.

spans.text: Persicaria, go in with Hannah to check on the operand acquisition. Sol and I will stand watch here.

units.rawText: Relax, it's only a bit of time. It won't help us escape, and it won't help them catch up to us either.
units.displayText: Relax, it's only a bit of time. It won't help us escape, and it won't help them catch up to us either.

spans.text: Relax, it's only a bit of time. It won't help us escape, and it won't help them catch up to us either.

units.rawText: I see. I'll go take care of it now.
units.displayText: I see. I'll go take care of it now.

units.displayText: Hannah leads Persicaria inside the Data Center.

units.rawText: Don't be scared. We'll get you safely out of here.
units.displayText: Don't be scared. We'll get you safely out of here.

spans.text: Don't be scared. We'll get you safely out of here.

units.rawText: ...I'm not scared, I'm just... I'm just thinking.
units.displayText: ...I'm not scared, I'm just... I'm just thinking.

units.displayText: Hannah presses the call button for the elevator and then looks at Persicaria.

spans.text: Hannah presses the call button for the elevator and then looks at Persicaria.

units.rawText: Do you know about the situation in the Rossum Sector? About what's happening between us and the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Do you know about the situation in the Rossum Sector? About what's happening between us and the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Do you know about the situation in the Rossum Sector? About what's happening between us and the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: I have a rough idea. It must have been a terrible experience.
units.displayText: I have a rough idea. It must have been a terrible experience.

spans.text: I have a rough idea. It must have been a terrible experience.

units.rawText: So from your perspective, do you think Turing's plan makes sense, Miss Persicaria?
units.displayText: So from your perspective, do you think Turing's plan makes sense, Miss Persicaria?

spans.text: So from your perspective, do you think Turing's plan makes sense, Miss Persicaria?

units.rawText: By which you mean...?
units.displayText: By which you mean...?

spans.text: By which you mean...?

units.rawText: What does sending me out of Rossum by myself accomplish? Running away doesn't solve the problem. Why don't we try to attack the problem at the source?
units.displayText: What does sending me out of Rossum by myself accomplish? Running away doesn't solve the problem. Why don't we try to attack the problem at the source?

spans.text: What does sending me out of Rossum by myself accomplish? Running away doesn't solve the problem. Why don't we try to attack the problem at the source?

units.rawText: You want to deal with the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: You want to deal with the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: You want to deal with the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: I heard you have the ability to do so. If you're willing to help me, I have a plan that could alter the current situation.
units.displayText: I heard you have the ability to do so. If you're willing to help me, I have a plan that could alter the current situation.

spans.text: I heard you have the ability to do so. If you're willing to help me, I have a plan that could alter the current situation.

units.displayText: I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to disappoint you, Hannah.

spans.text: I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to disappoint you, Hannah.

units.rawText: We can't take risks here. Your safety is our top priority. That's the promise we made to Turing.
units.displayText: We can't take risks here. Your safety is our top priority. That's the promise we made to Turing.
